children.html: Caresse is an app for adults who want a guided intimate audio experience together. It generates fiction on demand using your chosen names or aliases, preferences and boundaries, narrated by a synthetic voice. Demos are free; creating a personalized session uses paid credits, with no subscription.

Anonymous mode · No Caresse sign-up · Free demos
Paid personalized sessions, no subscription.

blocks.prefix:
Why Caresse?

A ritual designed for two.

No need to find the words. Caresse creates the space — you just need to be present for each other.

items.html:
💬

Communicate differently

The voice guides both partners, creating a shared experience that relieves the pressure of initiative and naturally opens conversation.

✨

Step outside routine

Every session is unique, AI-generated around your current desires. It's impossible to fall back into the same patterns — every time is a first time.

🎯

Personalized for both of you

Atmosphere, tone, dynamics, practices — you configure together what draws you in. Caresse adapts to your connection, not the other way around.

🔒

Private and secure

No explicit visual content. Your experiences remain private. Necessary settings are sent to generation services as described in the privacy policy.

blocks.prefix:
How it works

A shared experience in 4 steps
blocks.suffix:
Curious what that voice sounds like before installing the app? Listen to a Caresse couples demo — four minutes with James & Emma, first names spoken aloud and guidance alternating between you, no account or email needed.

The same guidance can also become an audio couples game: choose your preferences and boundaries, then let the voice set the pace, with no cards to read while listening.

blocks.prefix:
Frequently asked questions

Everything you want to know

children.html: Can I buy sessions in anonymous mode?

Yes. Anonymous mode lets you use Caresse and buy sessions without creating a Caresse account. Purchases go through the App Store or Google Play and require an Apple or Google account on the store you use, with its payment method. Anonymous mode applies to your use of Caresse, not to the transaction with the store.
How do you listen to Caresse together in the same room?
Caresse is designed to be experienced together in the same room. Use the speaker or connect to a bluetooth speaker for more presence and shared immersion.

Caresse offers varying intensity levels, from gentle romantic to more explicit. You choose exactly what suits you — no visual content in any case. The experience relies entirely on audio and your imagination.
Are our data and preferences shared?

Your experiences are not public or shared between users. Settings needed for generation are sent in pseudonymized form to AI and text-to-speech services. Your chosen first name or alias may be included, without your email or account identifier. Data sent to the language model (LLM) is used only to generate the scenario: the LLM does not retain it or use it to train its models. Caresse saves your experiences in your history so you can access them again; you can request their deletion under the privacy policy.
Can Caresse really reignite connection in a long-term couple?

Yes — one of the most commonly reported effects is the surprise it creates. The AI generates experiences you wouldn't have thought to suggest yourselves, creating novelty without effort or negotiation.
Do you need to be on the same phone?
No — each partner uses their own device. Caresse is available on iOS and Android. Configure the session together, then each launch it on your phone.
What if one of us is shy or uncomfortable with guided intimacy?
Caresse always starts gently and never pushes beyond what you've chosen. Configuring together is already a first step — you define boundaries before the session even begins.
